rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.1:
§lAdventure Tools§r

Tools that make exploring more fun.

To see how a tool works, hover over it in your inventory and hold §lShift§r.

All recipes are in the recipe book.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.2:
§lGrappling Hooks§r

Right-click to throw, again to retract.

Hook a block to be pulled. Hold §lShift§r to swing; Space climbs, S descends.

Hook a mob or item to pull it.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.3:
§l3D Maneuver Gear§r

Left click fires the left hook, right click the right one.

Two hooks together sling you around. Space: gas boost.

Empty? A gas canister from your inventory loads itself.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.4:
§lGlider & Boots§r

Hold the glider and fall to glide. Hot air above a lit campfire lifts you up!

Double jump boots let you jump once more in mid-air.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.5:
§lBackpacks§r

Right-click to open. Shift + right-click to wear it, then press §lB§r.

Upgrade with iron, gold and diamond; contents are kept.

Drop a pickup module onto it.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.6:
§lExploring§r

Prospector's spyglass: ores glow through walls.

Teleport compass: Shift to save, right-click to return.

Signal flare: light and red smoke.

Rope ladder: go down cliffs.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.7:
§lTraveling§r

Zipline: right-click two blocks, right-click an end to ride.

Sleeping bag: sleep anywhere without moving your spawn.

When you die, a death compass leads to your items.
rehber.maceraaletleri.sayfa.8:
§lKeys§r

§lM§r: magnet ring
§lB§r: worn backpack

Change them in Options → Controls.

Happy adventuring!
